title: improve-quant-kernels-int8-fp8-dequant-fusion-kvcache-batching
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Reduce end-to-end token latency and memory bandwidth for quantized inference while preserving model quality. This PR implements fused dequant+matmul kernels for INT8/FP8 paths, integrates smoothquant scaling support in the fused path, and extends KV cache support to store compressed INT8 keys/values with fast dequant on hot paths. It also updates the continuous-batching scheduler to prioritize compatible quantized kernels and adds heuristics to fall back to FP16 when required. Changes include new CUDA kernels, scheduler policy tweaks, KV cache format versioning, microbenchmarks, and end-to-end perf tests. Risks and mitigations: fused kernels change numeric ordering - added regression evals against a small set of reference prompts and a model-quality guard that skips fused paths if per-batch perplexity increase exceeds threshold. Backwards compatibility: KV cache adds a minor format version bump; on startup nodes handle both v1 and v2 caches with a migration path. Rollout notes: feature guarded behind runtime flag 'quant_dequant_fusion' and enabled gradually with canary traffic. Related work: builds on prior quantization improvements (ENG-1210) and addresses perf regressions observed during incident SUP-9123.
commits: Add smoothquant scaling support and parameter plumbing (src/runtime/kernels/quantized_kernels.cpp)
Extend KV cache to store INT8/FP8 representations and fast dequant path (src/runtime/kvcache/quant_kvcache.cpp)

Add unit tests and microbenchmarks (tests/perf/quant_kernels_bench.py, tests/unit/test_quant_kvcache.py)
Fix CI flakiness and add perf gating in CI (ci/perf_gates.yml)
Address reviewer feedback: fallback for models without smoothquant params, additional logging for cache format mismatches

release_notes: Performance: Add fused dequant+matmul kernels for INT8/FP8 - 1.8-2.4x throughput improvement on A100 for common response lengths.
